English translation of question: Man-made environmental problems such as deforestation and plastic in the oceans outrage me.

Question: Es gibt natürliche Grenzen des Wachstums, die unsere industrialisierte Welt längst erreicht hat.
English translation of question: There are natural limits to growth, which our industrialized world has long since reached.

English translation of question: For the sake of the environment, we should all be prepared to reduce our current standard of living.

English translation of question: We must find ways to live well independently of economic growth.
